title: camissonia paradoxa var. divaricata
intro: Camissonia paradoxa var. divaricata, commonly known as California suncup, is a plant species in the evening primrose family (Onagraceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and promote relaxation, making it useful for stress relief and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Camissonia paradoxa var. divaricata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
